Get RxNorm members of an RxClass class

Source: R/classes.R
get_class_members.Rd

get_class_members() queries the RxClass API to identify RxNorm drugs associated with a specific drug class. Depending on the relationship source, returned members may represent ingredients, clinical drugs, branded products, or other RxNorm concepts.

Usage

get_class_members(
  class_id,
  rela_source,
  rela = NULL,
  include_indirect = TRUE,
  ttys = NULL
)

Arguments

class_id

Character string identifying an RxClass class.

rela_source

RxClass relationship source, such as "ATC", "ATCPROD", "DAILYMED", "FDASPL", "MEDRT", "SNOMEDCT", or "VA".

rela

Optional character vector of RxClass relationship types. When multiple relationships are supplied, each is queried separately and the results are combined, preserving the relationship associated with each returned member. If NULL, no relationship filter is sent.

include_indirect

Logical. If TRUE (default), include direct and indirect members. If FALSE, return direct members only.

ttys

Optional character vector of RxNorm term types to retrieve, such as "IN", "PIN", "SCD", or "SBD".

Value

A tibble containing RxNorm class members, including their RxCUIs, names, term types, class identifiers, relationship sources, and relationships. Additional columns describe source-specific membership attributes when available.

Details

RxClass organizes drug-class membership using source-specific relationships. For ATC and ATCPROD, the rela argument can generally be omitted. Other sources, such as MEDRT and VA, use named relationships that may need to be specified explicitly.

For example, MEDRT associates drugs with diseases through distinct relationships, including may_treat and CI_with. These represent different clinical assertions and should not be interpreted as equivalent.

Use rxclass_relas() to identify relationship types supported by a source.

Multiple relationships can be supplied as a character vector. Each relationship is queried separately, and results are combined while preserving the originating relationship in the rela column.

If rela = NULL (default), no relationship filter is sent to the API. For non-ATC sources, a warning is issued when this produces no members, since an omitted relationship may explain the empty result.

See also

find_classes(), get_classes(), rxclass_relas()

Examples

if (identical(Sys.getenv("RXREF_ONLINE"), "1")) {
  # ATC class membership
  get_class_members("C02", "ATCPROD")

  # MED-RT: drugs associated with treating hypertension
  get_class_members("D006973", "MEDRT", rela = "may_treat")

  # MED-RT: retrieve multiple relationships
  get_class_members(
    "D006973", "MEDRT",
    rela = c("may_treat", "CI_with")
  )

  # VA drug class membership
  get_class_members("CV400", "VA", rela = "has_VAClass")
}
